note: Belize, read on the Immigration and Nationality Department's own pages (immigration.gov.bz) on 2026-10-30. A Temporary Employment Permit is applied for through the Labour Department by one residing in Belize (in country), then issued by Immigration on payment; entertainers performing alone pay BZ$600 for one week or less (BZ$1,000 for a group of two to five, BZ$1,500 for six or more), kept as a performer's permit (read as work for the engagement); self-employed workers pay BZ$3,000 for one year (owners or managers outside agriculture). CARICOM nationals who are artists, musicians, media workers and others hold a Skilled National Certificate (CSME), valid indefinitely, exempt from work permits, to live and work in any participating state: Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Belize, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, St Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, St Vincent and the Grenadines, Suriname and Trinidad and Tobago (Barbados, Dominica and St Vincent and the Grenadines also have full free movement with Belize from 1 October 2025, which the form doesn't separate). Permanent residence asks at least 1 year's legal residence in Belize, with no more than 14 days away (kept as each route's years to it); its fee depends on nationality, BZ$1,000 for CARICOM to BZ$6,000 for European countries (BZ$4,000 for other countries), which the form's single fee doesn't hold, so none is kept. The years naturalisation asks aren't on these pages.

sources.title: Immigration and Nationality Department (Belize), CSME
sources.said: The Certificate is valid for an indefinite period. ... The following categories of skilled workers are currently free to live and work in any CARICOM Country: Graduates of all recognized universities in the world, Artists, Musicians, Media Workers ... Holders of Skilled National Certificates are exempted from work permit requirements. ... Participating Countries for CSME Antigua & Barbuda Barbados Belize Dominica Grenada Guyana Jamaica St. Kitts & Nevis Saint Lucia St. Vincent & the Grenadines Suriname Trinidad & Tobago ... Participating Countries under the CSME Full Free Movement effective 01 October, 2025: Belize Barbados Dominica St. Vincent & the Grenadines

sources.title: Immigration and Nationality Department (Belize), Do You Qualify
sources.said: Have been legally residing in Belize for a minimum of 1 year at the time of submitting your application. During this year you have not left the country for more than 14 days in total.

sources.title: Immigration and Nationality Department (Belize), Residence Fees
sources.said: Permanent Residence fees are based on applicant’s nationality. ... CARICOM Countries $1,000.00 Central American Countries, Mexico and Dominican Republic $1,500.00 Commonwealth Countries $3,000.00 European Countries $6,000.00 Other Countries $4,000.00
